requirement: Execute scalar loads of the selected widths
test_behavior: The programs load byte, halfword, word, and doubleword values at the specified offsets and compare the destination register with the expected XLEN-wide value.

requirement: Execute stores of supported widths after commit
test_behavior: After each tested store, the program reads the addressed bytes back and checks the destination register. The comparator observes the readback and program completion.

requirement: Preserve results of dependent memory accesses
test_behavior: The programs check the results of dependent accesses and vary operand timing. Their register results do not distinguish forwarding from a stall followed by a load.
AMOADD.D must return the old value in a4; a subsequent LD checks the updated sum in a5. The program repeats the addition and checks both results again.

requirement: Observe the most recent older store when several stores remain pending
test_behavior: An older division delays retirement while three stores write distinct values to one address. The next load must place the third value in x20.
